title: Add independent literals for production-derived timing vectors
description: Correctness review found generate_packets_timing.py builds many canonical cross-language expected values directly from lichen.timing production (Trickle constants/FSM, DAO delays, CSMA constants/state, generic airtime rows, FNV slot/hash, startup and desync FSM), while test_packets_timing mostly compares the artifact to the same generator/production and only checks positivity/ranges for several categories. Independent arithmetic currently covers duty-cycle and TDMA max-airtime but not the rest. Add spec-derived literal/second-implementation checks for every production-derived category (or make the generator independent) so a Python regression cannot rewrite the shared Rust/Python oracle and pass its own consumer.
